(1) On empty asphalt at dusk, the car's own badge lies alone on the ground; a glossy black liquid like living tar crawls in on clawed tendrils and grabs it; (2) the liquid swallows the badge and swells into a shiny black sphere, then bursts flat into a ring of spiky tendrils; (3) the tendrils weave the chassis, the engine and the wheels piece by piece, black liquid flowing over each part as it forms; (4) the liquid slides off the bodywork and the finished car from the photo stands there, headlights flicking on. No text, no captions, no faces or characters in the liquid, no watermark.
